title: Mixed Methods Workbench
north_star: Brian, 2026-11-06: "on mixed mtheod work bench finsih that is not for a specific use case it is part of my broader vision". Finish the workbench to 1.0 as a general tool: a governed corpus, a qualitative strand read from Qualitative Coding, a quantitative strand checked against human coding, a joint display with bounded meta-inference, a gated causal check, review and export, proven on two rights-clear corpora (docs/plans/008_finish_workbench.md).
thesis: Methods stay in their own repositories; the workbench freezes the corpus, reads each method's export, owns the narrow quantitative adapter no repository has, and joins the strands with every claim traceable to its passage.
disproof: On a second rights-clear corpus added without code changes, the quantitative strand fails to agree with the authors' coding beyond chance, or the planted failures pass the checks unnoticed.
not_for: Running a qualitative method inside the workbench, a universal schema or method planner, contacting corpus authors, or publishing an unreviewed causal conclusion.
